stories.headline: India’s Finance Minister blames easy exits and excess liquidity for equity market's underperformance
stories.blurb: India's finance minister said that continued capital outflows are one of the biggest risks for the country in 2027.

stories.headline: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
stories.blurb: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.

stories.headline: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
stories.blurb: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

stories.headline: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
stories.blurb: Investors expect the Fed to pause rate hikes in October, but Kevin Warsh's rejection of traditional communications practices and continued concern about inflation leave the decision uncertain.

stories.headline: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
stories.blurb: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

stories.headline: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
stories.blurb: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

stories.headline: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
stories.blurb: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

stories.headline: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
stories.blurb: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

stories.blurb: The Airbus jet landed safely in Bulgaria and all passengers and crew aboard were unharmed, officials said.

stories.blurb: Exports have helped offset weak spending at home, but trade tensions and AI doubts cloud its outlook.

stories.headline: People playing loud music on buses could face £100 fine
stories.blurb: Antisocial behaviour on buses in England could lead to fines while a new campaign is also being launched for trains. A national campaign asking rail passengers "share the carriage, not the noise" is being launched.

stories.headline: EU tariffs aimed at China hitting Ukraine, steel boss says
stories.blurb: The boss of one of Ukraine's biggest steel companies says the country has been "bundled together" in measures aimed at curbing cheap imports.

stories.headline: Don't fall for this - how to protect yourself from AI scams
